assumptions.choice: Use Backtrader Stop orders placed after each completed entry at 2% beyond the actual entry price.
assumptions.reason: A stop loss is most literally represented as a stop order that triggers when the market reaches the stated threshold.

assumptions.choice: Close the existing position only; do not reverse on the same signal.
assumptions.reason: The canonical convention prohibits re-entry while a position is open, and the specification says to exit on the opposite crossover.
